title: The Ancient Scroll
description: Fitz has entrusted you with an ancient scroll. The scroll reveals that the author's treasure key has been broken into three pieces, each hidden behind a unique test: Forge (magnetic field), Mind (hidden under stars), and Strength (earth-moving power). Show the scroll to those who might know more about each piece, then return with all three relic shards.

objectives.description: Read the scroll and seek out those who can help solve each clue.
Collect all three relic shards from the Forge, Mind, and Strength tests.
Show the three relic shards to Fitzwilliam.
Combine the shards to complete the relic.
